accepted.quote: Instead of addressing any actual problem for workers and their families, the bill would advance a misguided agenda to distract public attention from poverty-level compensation and likely misclassification by unscrupulous companies.
accepted.bill: H.R. 1320, the Modern Worker Security Act
accepted.rationale: The passage characterizes the bill as misguided and as distracting from low pay and misclassification.
